title: Garden
statementMd:
Luba thinks about watering her garden. The garden can be represented as a segment of length $*k*$. Luba has got $*n*$ buckets, the $*i*$-th bucket allows her to water some continuous subsegment of garden of length **exactly** $*a*_{*i*}$ each hour. **Luba can't water any parts of the garden that were already watered, also she can't water the ground outside the garden**.

Luba has to choose **one** of the buckets in order to water the garden as fast as possible (as mentioned above, each hour she will water some continuous subsegment of length $*a*_{*i*}$ if she chooses the $*i*$-th bucket). Help her to determine the minimum number of hours she has to spend watering the garden. It is guaranteed that Luba can always choose a bucket so it is possible water the garden.

See the examples for better understanding.

## Input

The first line of input contains two integer numbers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *k* ≤ 100$) — the number of buckets and the length of the garden, respectively.

The second line of input contains $*n*$ integer numbers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$) — the length of the segment that can be watered by the $*i*$-th bucket in one hour.

It is guaranteed that there is at least one bucket such that it is possible to water the garden in integer number of hours using only this bucket.

## Output

Print one integer number — the minimum number of hours required to water the garden.

## Note

In the first test the best option is to choose the bucket that allows to water the segment of length $3$. We can't choose the bucket that allows to water the segment of length $5$ because then we can't water the whole garden.

In the second test we can choose only the bucket that allows us to water the segment of length $1$.
statementZhMd:
Luba 正在考虑给她的花园浇水。花园可以表示为长度为 $*k*$ 的线段。Luba 有 $*n*$ 个水桶，第 $*i*$ 个水桶允许她每小时浇灌花园中某个长度**恰好**为 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的连续子线段。**Luba 不能浇灌花园中已经浇过水的部分，也不能浇灌花园外的地面。**

Luba 必须选择**一个**水桶，以尽可能快地浇完整个花园（如上所述，如果她选择第 $*i*$ 个水桶，那么每小时她都会浇灌某个长度为 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的连续子线段）。请帮助她确定浇灌整个花园所需的最少小时数。保证 Luba 总能选择一个水桶，从而能够浇完整个花园。

请参见样例以更好地理解题意。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *k* ≤ 100$），分别表示水桶的数量和花园的长度。

输入的第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$），表示第 $*i*$ 个水桶每小时能够浇灌的线段长度。

保证至少存在一个水桶，使得只使用该水桶可以在整数小时内浇完整个花园。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即浇完整个花园所需的最少小时数。

## 说明

在第一个测试中，最好的选择是使用能够浇灌长度为 $3$ 的线段的水桶。不能选择能够浇灌长度为 $5$ 的线段的水桶，因为这样无法浇完整个花园。

在第二个测试中，我们只能选择能够浇灌长度为 $1$ 的线段的水桶。
